Bash(node -e "const idx = require\('./data/decklists-index.json'\); const byTournament = {}; for \(const e of idx\) { const parts = e.file.split\('/'\); const fname = parts[parts.length-1]; let t = 'unknown'; if \(fname.startsWith\('houston-rq'\)\) t='houston'; else if \(fname.startsWith\('bologna-rq'\)\) t='bologna'; else if \(fname.startsWith\('vegas-rq'\) || fname.startsWith\('las-vegas'\)\) t='vegas'; else if \(fname.startsWith\('lille-rq'\)\) t='lille'; else if \(fname.startsWith\('shanghai-cc'\)\) t='shanghai-cc'; else if \(fname.startsWith\('guangzhou'\)\) t='guangzhou'; else if \(fname.startsWith\('chongqing'\)\) t='chongqing'; else if \(fname.startsWith\('s3-xian'\)\) t='xian'; else if \(fname.startsWith\('sydney'\) || fname.startsWith\('best-of'\)\) t='sydney'; else if \(fname.startsWith\('atlanta'\)\) t='atlanta'; else t=fname.slice\(0,20\); byTournament[t] = \(byTournament[t]||0\)+1; } console.log\(JSON.stringify\(byTournament, null, 2\)\);")
